rule: These protocols are distinct from the simulation reference in scenarios.json and from each other. None is executed by harness.mjs; `status` only reports whether their retained evidence is reachable and hashes it. Historical figures are evidence of the revision that produced them, never a pass for the native port. Absence of measured-twin access is a named blocker, not a reason for synthetic replacement evidence.

protocols.description: TypeScript engine reference over the pinned simulated scenario set (checked-in instances, pinned-site compiles, ambient populations, frozen situation fixtures, threshold-near derivations); discrete-exact plus tolerance-classed numeric comparison against a native candidate. Executed by `harness.mjs record` / `compare`. The frozen TS source for later candidate façades is the Main-owned copy under /mnt/storage/simforge-native-migration/reference-source; runs against native-backed packages/{engine,compiler,training-env} are candidates, never references.

Original O2 fidelity protocol over the 20 sample scenes: three SF seeds and three AS runs per scene, majority agreement threshold 16/20 (0.80). Historical inventory records 15/20 (0.75) majority agreement with five both-fail cases; the corrected collection (60 SF episodes) is recorded as not run. Never merge historical agreements with corrected disagreements.

evidence.role: local NuRec port provenance and scope
complete local scene bundle (one of twenty)

protocols.description: Training cohort of 24 scenes. Excluded from the O2 original-20 denominator by protocol (includedInO2: false); it is its own qualification and may never substitute for the original-20 gate.

Measured-twin evidence for the twin fork. Only a lossy public-history API projection (129 production observations) is retained locally; the transaction-consistent SQLite export and calibration lineage are not reachable (Tailscale authorization). Missing rows, frames and calibration are not manufactured.

Renderer output identity and determinism are qualified by the existing golden harness, render-determinism harness and render qualification program, not by the simulation reference. Bake-off timings are workload-specific residency evidence, not native-port predictions.
